title: AssetSearchRequest
description: Search request body for querying assets with filters, sorting, and pagination.

AssetEnrichment.title: AssetEnrichment
AssetEnrichment.description: Optional enrichment data to include with asset results.

asset_properties.description: Properties directly tied to the asset or DNS you want to filter on

certificate_properties.description: Properties related to certificates on the asset you want to filter on

exposure_properties.description: Properties relating to exposures found on assets you wish to filter on

technology_properties.description: Properties related to open ports and technologies identified on the asset

quick_search.description: Quick search across asset name, IP addresses, and technology fields

AssetFilter.title: AssetFilter
AssetFilter.description: Filter criteria for asset search queries.

asset_id.description: Filter for the specific asset, which will be either a IP or domain value (examples: `192.88.99.2` or `www.example.com`).

name.description: Filter on the name of the asset(IP address or domain).

static_asset.description: Filter static and non static assets.

apex.title: Apex
apex.description: Filter on the apex domain of the assets. Only makes sense for `domain` asset types. Example: `example.com`

added_to_project.description: Filter on the date (Y-m-d) the asset was added to the project. This may be different than when the asset was discovered.

discovered.description: Filter on the date (Y-m-d) the asset was discovered by Recorded Future ASI. This may be different than when the asset was added to the project. IPv4 addresses will have a fixed point in the past for their discovery date.

asset_type.description: The type of asset, one of: `ip`, `domain` and `host`(where `domain` and `host` represent the same asset type).

referenced_ip.title: Referenced Ip
referenced_ip.description: Filter on an A or CNAME record pointing to the IP address. Use `eq` or `in` for exact IP matching. Use `contains` with a trailing `.` for CIDR range matching, or without for prefix matching.

cname_reference.title: Cname Reference
cname_reference.description: Filter on a domain that is referenced by a CNAME record. Only makes sense for `domain` asset types. Treated as a wildcard, so `example.com` will match `www.example.com`.

referenced_ip_at.description: If filtering on a `referenced_ip`, include additional criteria that the record existed during a date range.

valid_record_type.title: Valid Record Type
valid_record_type.description: Filter for assets that have this DNS record type, e.g. `A`,`CNAME`,`MX`.

dns_resolves.description: Filter for assets that in the end resolve to a valid IP currently, either via an `A` or `CNAME`. `IP`-assets is included when filtering for assets that resolve.

custom_tags.title: Custom Tags
custom_tags.description: Filter by custom tags placed on your assets. `strict` version will return a validation error if any of the tags have not been defined on your project. By using `*` you can filter for assets that have at least one custom tag applied. By using an empty(`[]`) list you can filter for assets that have no custom tags applied.

custom_tags_strict.title: Custom Tags Strict
custom_tags_strict.description: Filter by custom tags placed on your assets. `strict` version will return a validation error if any of the tags have not been defined on your project. By using `*` you can filter for assets that have at least one custom tag applied. By using an empty(`[]`) list you can filter for assets that have no custom tags applied.

asn.title: Asn
asn.description: Filter for assets which either are, or point to, an IP address announced by the provided ASN (e.g. `16509`).

ip_geo_country_iso.title: Ip Geo Country Iso
ip_geo_country_iso.description: Filter for assets which either are, or point to, an IP address located in the provided ISO country code (e.g. `US`).

ip_owner.title: Ip Owner
ip_owner.description: Filter for assets which either are, or point to, an IP address owned by the provided organization. This will often be an ISP or hosting provider or simply the name of the AS owning the IP.

registry.title: Registry
registry.description: Filter for assets by their IP registry source (e.g., 'arin', 'ripe', 'apnic').

whois_email_current.title: Whois Email Current
whois_email_current.description: Filter for assets where the WHOIS email address matches the provided value. For subdomains the parent record will be partially used. The `current` variant will only return results where the email is on the current (rather than historical) versions of the WHOIS.

whois_email.title: Whois Email
whois_email.description: Filter for assets where the WHOIS email address matches the provided value. For subdomains the parent record will be partially used. The `current` variant will only return results where the email is on the current (rather than historical) versions of the WHOIS.

AssetPropertiesFilter.title: AssetPropertiesFilter
AssetPropertiesFilter.description: Filter options for asset properties (hostname, IP, tags, ports, etc.).

AssetSortField.title: AssetSortField
AssetSortField.description: Field to sort asset results by.

certificate_subject.title: Certificate Subject
certificate_subject.description: Filter where certificate `subject` or `organizationName` matches the provided value

certificate_subject_alt_name.title: Certificate Subject Alt Name
certificate_subject_alt_name.description: Filter here the certificate Subject Alternate Names section matches the provided value

certificate_sha256.description: Filter where the certificate public key sha256 value matches the provided value

certificate_expires_at.description: Filter where the certificate expiration matches the provided value

certificate_issued_at.description: Filter where the certificate issuance date matches the provided value

certificate_issuer.title: Certificate Issuer
certificate_issuer.description: Filter where the certificate (or in the chain) issuer's common name or organization matches the provided value

certificate_covers_domain.title: Certificate Covers Domain
certificate_covers_domain.description: Filter where the certificate's subject common name domain or one of the Subject Alternate Names exactly matches or is a wildcard covering the provided value

CertificatePropertiesFilter.title: CertificatePropertiesFilter
CertificatePropertiesFilter.description: Filter options for certificate properties (issuer, expiration, etc.).

DateRangeFilter.title: DateRangeFilter
DateRangeFilter.description: Date range filter with from/to bounds.

EmailInFilter.title: EmailInFilter
EmailInFilter.description: Email address inclusion filter (matches any in list).

severity.title: Severity
severity.description: Filter for assets which have an exposure severity matching or higher than the provided value. Acceptable values: unknown, informational, moderate, critical.

signature_id.title: Signature Id
signature_id.description: Filter for assets which have an exposure with the provided ASI Signature ID. Note that some signatures line up with CVEs, but this should not be relied upon. Examples: `cve-2024-6387`, `cve-OpenSSH`.

asset_exposure_score.description: Filter for assets which have an exposure score within the provided range. This is a score from 0-100 that indicates the potential risk of the asset based on various factors. You may specify only one 'end' based on your needs.

last_scanned_at.description: Filter on the date (Y-m-d) when the asset was last scanned for exposures.

ExposurePropertiesFilter.title: ExposurePropertiesFilter
ExposurePropertiesFilter.description: Filter options for exposure properties (severity, signature, etc.).

InFilter.title: InFilter
InFilter.description: Value inclusion filter (matches any in list).

IntRangeFilter.title: IntRangeFilter
IntRangeFilter.description: Integer range filter with min/max bounds.

next_cursor.title: Next Cursor
next_cursor.description: An opaque value which should be passed as the `cursor` to retrieve the next page of results. If None or not present there are no remaining pages. This value should not be interpreted by the client.

limit.title: Limit
limit.description: The number of items to return

search.title: Search
search.description: Search term to match against asset name, IP addresses, and technology fields

QuickSearchFilter.title: QuickSearchFilter
QuickSearchFilter.description: Quick search text filter for assets.

RequireAllFilter.title: RequireAllFilter
RequireAllFilter.description: Filter requiring all specified values to match.

open_port_number.title: Open Port Number
open_port_number.description: Filter for assets which have an open port with the provided number (e.g. `80`).

open_port_service.title: Open Port Service
open_port_service.description: Filter for assets which have an open port that appears to support the provided protocol (e.g. `http`, `rdp`, `ftp`).

open_port_protocol.title: Open Port Protocol
open_port_protocol.description: Filter for assets which have an open port on the provided protocol (e.g. `tcp`, `udp`).

open_port_technology.title: Open Port Technology
open_port_technology.description: Filter for assets which have a specific product listening on an open port (e.g. `nginx`, `apache httpd`)

waf_detected.description: Filter for assets where a WAF (Web Application Firewall) is detected.

waf_name.title: Waf Name
waf_name.description: Filter for assets where a specific WAF is detected. Will attempt to match both vendor and product, e.g. `Cloudflare`.

technology_name.title: Technology Name
technology_name.description: Filter for the name of a technology found on the asset. Could be directly attached to the port (`nginx`, etc) or a web technology (e.g. 'jQuery', 'Wordpress')

web_technology_name.title: Web Technology Name
web_technology_name.description: Filter for the name of a technology specifically associated with 'web' resources, such as `jQuery` or `Wordpress`). **NOTE**: In some cases where a port has been closed we may still report findings of web technologies that we previously saw on those ports.

is_responsive.description: Filter for assets that are unresponsive over ICMP and no ports are open. This is a boolean filter, so it will return assets that are either responsive or not responsive.

TechnologyPropertiesFilter.title: TechnologyPropertiesFilter
TechnologyPropertiesFilter.description: Filter options for technology properties (name, version, vendor, etc.).
